QuestInfo.name: Victory and Defeat
QuestInfo.0: Everyone is celebrating...except you. Magnus's power was overwhelming, and it seems unlikely that you could retake Heliseum at this point.
QuestInfo.1: Magnus seems impossible to beat. Wouldn't it be better to reinforce the Protective Shield and defend? Maybe you should discuss this with the #bHeliseum Protector Vanguard at their hideout. Meet #p3000016##k and talk it over.
QuestInfo.2: You tried to talk to #p3000016#, but he's not having any of it. This is not good.

0.0: Man...this is the perfect time to party and celebrate how powerful I am. And yet...Magnus ruined all of that. How can be be so strong? How can we retake Heliseum? Is there anything I can do about this with my awesome Kaiserness?

yes.0: AND, Magnus has Kaiserium. That's totally unfair. How am I supposed to beat that?
yes.1: Hey, I wonder how #p3000007# is doing? He and the Angelic Buster got pretty messed up too. Maybe I should visit #b#m400020300##k and spread some Kaiser cheer.

no.0: I just can't believe he one-shotted me. That's so lame.

npc.0: I'm on my way to #b#m400020300# to meet #p3000016##k.
